loreReference: white marble, gold laurel, bronze weapons, violet heavens, amphitheaters suspended above clouds
canonAuthority: Current Titan Gates canon/lore data layer. 3D Asset Director may translate scale and production needs but may not override Lore Director.

scale.rule: All dimensions reference Master_Scale_Reference; individual creators may not invent scale.

battlefieldClearance.gridReadability: Must remain readable in elongated 3D tactical battlefield presentation.

mobilePerformanceTarget: 60fps target on mobile tactical view; silhouette readable at 360x640.

technicalNotes.polygonBudget: Mobile-first production target: LOD0 budget assigned by asset type during model pass; validators require LOD0/LOD1/LOD2/CollisionMesh entries before GAME_READY.
technicalNotes.textureResolution: 1024-2048 for heroes/Titans and Gates; 512-1024 for common creatures/props; atlas-friendly mobile materials.
technicalNotes.collisionRequirements: Separate simplified collision mesh; never derive gameplay collision from high-detail art mesh.
technicalNotes.rigRequirements: Rig spec required before MODEL_IN_PROGRESS; Titans and creatures need named root, pelvis/chest/head, limb, weapon, and VFX sockets where canon supports them.
technicalNotes.animationRequirements: Idle, movement, attack/interaction, hit reaction, death/disable, and any canon ability poses when source data defines them.
technicalNotes.mobileOptimization: Preserve silhouette and scale at 360px width; use baked lighting/material zones and aggressive LOD swaps.

validation.readyCriteria: All required views linked, scale/material/gameplay dimensions defined, dependencies valid, and status at least VALIDATED.
